acceptanceCriteria: proposal.md/design.md/tasks.md under active and archived OpenSpec changes are indexed with proposed/archived status and repository-spec authority.
A spec amendment to STA-V0-007 and contextindex tests; analyzer schema bumped.
body: STA-V0-007 (V1-1695) classifies only files the context index already admits as documents. OpenSpec change artefacts proposal.md, design.md and tasks.md under openspec/changes/<id>/ are not indexed as documents because their names miss the spec heuristics, so context for an active OpenSpec change omits its proposal and design. Idea: admit them as documents with status proposed (archived under archive/), never binding.
title: Index OpenSpec change artefacts (proposal.md, design.md, tasks.md) as proposed documents
